versions.changelog:
- Clarified: Skill description now strictly prohibits prompt rewriting or workflow construction—requests are just relayed to the backend.
- Expanded: Scope now explicitly covers new use cases—short drama, webtoon, manga, batch generation, text/image/audio-to-video, and edits.
- Added: Content moderation section forbidding deepfakes, non-consensual impersonation, and political disinformation.
- Updated: Tag list, forbidden operations, and usage guidelines for broader creative workflows and regulatory compliance.
- User experience: Guidance on complex tasks and retry handling is emphasized.
- No functional or code changes—documentation and policy clarifications only.

**Initial scriptable integration for VoooAI NL2Workflow creative platform.**

- Added first set of Python scripts to perform key workflow actions: capability discovery, file upload, workflow generation, execution (full and node), status monitoring, and result download.
- Authentication now required via environment variable `VOOOAI_ACCESS_KEY`.
- SKILL.md updated: clear definitions for allowed operations, boundaries, and usage examples. Non-workflow/account/billing/admin operations are explicitly out of scope.
- Use this skill for any natural language request involving AI-based image, video, music, digital human, or storyboard generation and editing.
- All creative and workflow logic is delegated to VoooAI’s backend; this skill acts as a command relay/proxy.

Initial release of VoooAI skill — an all-in-one AI multimedia NL2Workflow platform for rapid creative production.

- Instantly generate images, videos, music, and digital humans from natural language requests in Chinese or English.
- 70+ built-in creative skills across 20+ verticals: advertising, drama, education, game assets, social media content, and more.
- End-to-end automated workflows: scriptwriting, storyboard, content generation, music, editing, and digital narration — no manual prompting or configuration needed.
- All major AI models are integrated and ready to use: Nano Banana Pro, FLUX2, Sora2, Veo3.1, Seedance2, Kling O3, Suno V5, OmniHuman 1.5.
- Accepts URL and PDF input for reference-based content creation.
- Always-on cloud service with free tier and zero downtime.
